services.desc: The Peabody will hosts yoga classes in the Burke Hall of Dinosaurs and our Mineral Galleries. Expert yoga instructors from Yale Campus Recreation provide a welcoming, inclusive atmosphere. All experience levels welcome. Participants must be 16 years or older. Classes must be booked at least 24 hours in advance. Please bring your own Yoga mat, towel, and water bottle. services.name: Wedding Rentals
services.desc: Celebrate life’s most meaningful moments surrounded by the wonder of natural history at the Yale Peabody Museum. Our newly renovated galleries offer a stunning and memorable backdrop for weddings, receptions, and private celebrations. From dining beneath towering dinosaurs to hosting cocktails among world-class exhibits, the Peabody provides an unforgettable setting in the heart of New Haven. Wedding events at the Yale Peabody take place after public museum hours, which end at 5:00 PM daily (except Mondays). This allows couples and their guests to enjoy the museum in a more private and exclusive setting. The earliest event start time is 6:00 PM, which allows adequate time for event setup
